title: Switch on evaluated acceptance for the Engram project store
outcome: Completion on the Engram project store requires a recorded per-criterion acceptance evaluation; the legacy self-asserted path is off.
acceptance: on that store done without an evaluation is refused and names evaluate as the remedy, and done after a passing evaluation seals with provenance evaluated

the active control policy of the Engram store carries an acceptance-evaluation setting that allows same_session and independent_session with mechanical basis asserted, activated in Greg's name with an auditable reason

completion.summary: Evaluated acceptance is active on the Engram project store at policy epoch 2 (same_session and independent_session allowed, mechanical basis asserted), activated in Greg's name. The live store refused done without an evaluation and named evaluate as the remedy; this completion is the first on the store sealed from a recorded per-criterion evaluation. PhoenixCodeNav is unchanged.
